Department.department_id: TEXT; required; primary key; immutable DEPT-NNN identifier.
Department.department_name: TEXT; required; unique; one of the synthetic department names.
Department.effective_to: DATE; optional; NULL while current; must be on/after effective_from.

Requester.requester_id: TEXT; required; primary key; REQ-NNNN format.
Requester.full_name: TEXT; required; synthetic employee label; not a real person's identity.
Requester.email: TEXT; required; unique; reserved example.test domain.
Requester.effective_to: DATE; optional; NULL while current; not earlier than effective_from.

Budget.budget_id: TEXT; required; primary key; BUD-NNN-2026 format.
Budget.department_id: TEXT; required; FK to Department; one departmental budget per fiscal year in baseline.

Supplier.supplier_id: TEXT; required; primary key; SUP-NNN format.
Supplier.risk_score: INTEGER; required; 0..100; higher means greater risk.

PurchaseRequest.purchase_request_id: TEXT; required; primary key; PR-2026-NNNNNN format.
PurchaseRequest.department_id: TEXT; required; FK to Department; must agree with Requester department.
PurchaseRequest.budget_id: TEXT; required; FK to Budget; must agree with Department and fiscal year.
PurchaseRequest.estimated_total: DECIMAL(14,2); required; non-negative; sum of RequestLine estimated_line_total.
PurchaseRequest.status: ENUM; required; DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED.
PurchaseRequest.duplicate_of_request_id: TEXT; optional; self-FK to PurchaseRequest; only populated for known duplicate case.
PurchaseRequest.split_group_id: TEXT; optional; links related requests suspected of split purchasing.

RequestLine.request_line_id: TEXT; required; primary key; PRL-request-counter format.
RequestLine.line_number: INTEGER; required; positive; unique within request.
RequestLine.category: ENUM; required; IT_HARDWARE, SOFTWARE, OFFICE_SUPPLIES, FACILITIES, PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES, NETWORKING.

RFQ.rfq_id: TEXT; required; primary key; RFQ-2026-NNNNNN format.
RFQ.purchase_request_id: TEXT; required; FK to PurchaseRequest; unique in this baseline.
RFQ.status: ENUM; required; DRAFT, ISSUED, CLOSED, AWARDED, CANCELLED.

RFQSupplier.composite uniqueness: UNIQUE(rfq_id, supplier_id); implements RFQ N:M Supplier.

SupplierQuote.quote_id: TEXT; required; primary key; QUO-supplier-code-2026-NNNNNN format.
SupplierQuote.valid_until: DATETIME; required; on/after quote_date; must cover award timestamp.
SupplierQuote.currency: ENUM; required; INR in baseline; mismatch anomaly deliberately labelled.
SupplierQuote.status: ENUM; required; RECEIVED, AWARDED, REJECTED, EXPIRED.
SupplierQuote.award_rationale: TEXT; optional; required when selected quote is not lowest eligible landed cost.
SupplierQuote.is_selected: BOOLEAN; required; only one selected quote per awarded RFQ.

QuoteLine.quantity: INTEGER; required; must match requested quantity.

PurchaseOrder.purchase_order_id: TEXT; required; primary key; PO-2026-NNNNNN format.
PurchaseOrder.purchase_request_id: TEXT; required; FK to PurchaseRequest; unique in baseline.
PurchaseOrder.rfq_id: TEXT; optional; FK to RFQ; NULL for single-source.
PurchaseOrder.awarded_quote_id: TEXT; optional; FK to SupplierQuote; NULL for single-source.
PurchaseOrder.award_rationale: TEXT; required for single-source or non-lowest award exceptions.

Delivery.delivery_id: TEXT; required; primary key; DEL-PO-id-NN format.
Delivery.quantity_received: INTEGER; required; between 0 and ordered per delivery event; cumulative receipts <= PO line quantity.
Delivery.delivery_exception_reason: TEXT; optional; populated for partial delivery events.

StatusEvent.entity_id: TEXT; required; identifier of subject; validated against entity tables by application logic.

AuditLog.action: TEXT; required; CREATE, ISSUE, STATE_CHANGE, etc.
